title: Heartbeat Scramble
native_title: ハートビート・スクランブル
overview:
- Simulated experience of three years of high school life
- Casting by audition
- Multi-ending system

Heartbeat Scramble is a romance simulation in which you spend three years as a high school boy. The girls you meet and the places you go are shown in live-action photos and video, while dialogue plays out below with small cartoon versions of the cast.

You get one action each day, so choose how to spend your time - going to class, drives, trips to the beach and more. Who you get close to decides how your high school days end.

- Memory backup

高校3年間の生活を疑似体験
